name: Economy
description: Managing resources by building workers, expanding to new bases, and scaling production while avoiding oversaturation or resource float.

name: Army
description: Creating the right units, managing their upgrades, and controlling them effectively in battle (micro and composition).

name: Build Orders
description: Executing a planned sequence of actions that reaches specific goals at specific timings, such as unit production, expansion, or tech.

name: Scouting
description: Gaining and denying information to assess the opponent’s strategy, predict timings, and adapt your own plan accordingly.

name: Strategy
description: Long-term game planning and decision-making, including how to win given your opponent’s behavior, tech path, or map situation.

name: Tactics
description: Short-term decisions involving positioning, engagements, harassment, and exploiting terrain to gain advantages in fights.

name: Map Control
description: Maintaining vision, limiting the opponent’s movement, denying expansions, and safely controlling parts of the map for strategic advantage.

name: Mechanics
description: Your execution ability: efficient APM, hotkey use, multitasking, avoiding supply blocks, and making fast, accurate inputs under pressure.

name: Other
description: Anything that doesn't fit into the other categories, such as specific unit interactions, map-specific strategies, or unique game mechanics.
